footer.overdueRateValue: Loan rate + up to 3% per annum (within legal maximum rate of 20%). Applicable only to contracts renewed from July 7, 2021.
footer.noFees: No additional fees or early repayment penalties. Interest is charged monthly on the agreed date. Repayment amounts may vary depending on loan terms and repayment method (e.g., for a 1 million KRW loan at 20% annual rate over 12 months with equal principal and interest payments, total repayment is 1,111,614 KRW). Loan approval may be restricted for those with public information, credit assessment data, or default records. Consumers have the right to receive sufficient explanation from financial sales providers. Please read the product description and terms before signing the contract. If scheduled payments are overdue, you may be required to repay all principal and interest before the contract expires.
footer.creditWarning: Taking out a loan or borrowing beyond your repayment capacity may lower your credit rating and personal credit score. A decrease in personal credit score may result in disadvantages in financial transactions.
footer.debtWarning: Excessive debt can bring great misfortune to you.
footer.illegalFees: It is illegal to charge brokerage fees separately from interest.
